# Song-level Acoustic Analysis

```{r}
library(readr)
Song_Level_Data <- read_csv("Song_Level_Data.csv")
View(Song_Level_Data)


colnames(Song_Level_Data)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Load song-level dataset

Song_Level_Data <- read_csv("Song_Level_Data.csv")


# Wilcoxon tests


wilcox_results <- data.frame(
  
  Feature = c(
    "Minimum frequency",
    "Maximum frequency",
    "Frequency bandwidth",
    "Mean centre frequency",
    "Peak frequency",
    "Duration",
    "Note count",
    "Note pace"
  ),
  
  W = c(
    wilcox.test(Low.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$statistic,
    wilcox.test(High.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$statistic,
    wilcox.test(Delta.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$statistic,
    wilcox.test(Mean.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$statistic,
    wilcox.test(Peak.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$statistic,
    wilcox.test(Delta.Time..s. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$statistic,
    wilcox.test(Note_Count ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$statistic,
    wilcox.test(Note_Pace ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$statistic
  ),
  
  p_value = c(
    wilcox.test(Low.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(High.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(Delta.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(Mean.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(Peak.Freq..Hz. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(Delta.Time..s. ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(Note_Count ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$p.value,
    wilcox.test(Note_Pace ~ Sex, data = Song_Level_Data)$p.value
  )
)

wilcox_results$p_value <- signif(wilcox_results$p_value, 4)

print(wilcox_results)

write.csv(
  wilcox_results,
  "Song_Level_Wilcoxon_Results.csv", row.names = FALSE)





# SONG-LEVEL ACOUSTIC ANALYSIS
# Box/Violin plots + Wilcoxon rank-sum tests



# 1. Load packages


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)



# 2. Load song-level dataset


Song_Level_Data <- read_csv("Song_Level_Data.csv")
View(Song_Level_Data)
colnames(Song_Level_Data)



# 3. Select and rename acoustic variables


df_plot <- Song_Level_Data %>%
  select(
    Sex,
    Low.Freq..Hz.,
    High.Freq..Hz.,
    Delta.Freq..Hz.,
    Mean.Freq..Hz.,
    Peak.Freq..Hz.,
    Delta.Time..s.,
    Note_Count,
    Note_Pace
  ) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  rename(
    "Minimum frequency (Hz)" = Low.Freq..Hz.,
    "Maximum frequency (Hz)" = High.Freq..Hz.,
    "Frequency bandwidth (Hz)" = Delta.Freq..Hz.,
    "Mean centre frequency (Hz)" = Mean.Freq..Hz.,
    "Peak frequency (Hz)" = Peak.Freq..Hz.,
    "Duration (s)" = Delta.Time..s.,
    "Note count" = Note_Count,
    "Note pace" = Note_Pace
  )



# 4. Convert to long format


long_df <- df_plot %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Sex,
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Value"
  )



# 5. Set exact order of acoustic variables


long_df$Feature <- factor(
  long_df$Feature,
  levels = c(
    "Minimum frequency (Hz)",
    "Maximum frequency (Hz)",
    "Frequency bandwidth (Hz)",
    "Mean centre frequency (Hz)",
    "Peak frequency (Hz)",
    "Duration (s)",
    "Note count",
    "Note pace"
  )
)



# 6. Wilcoxon rank-sum test for all variables


wilcox_results <- long_df %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    W = as.numeric(
      wilcox.test(Value ~ Sex)$statistic
    ),
    p_value = wilcox.test(Value ~ Sex)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# View results
print(wilcox_results)


# 7. Save Wilcoxon results


write.csv(
  wilcox_results,
  "Song_Level_Wilcoxon_Results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# 8. Prepare p-value labels for figure


pvals <- long_df %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    W = as.numeric(
      wilcox.test(Value ~ Sex)$statistic
    ),
    p_value = wilcox.test(Value ~ Sex)$p.value,
    ymax = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label = ifelse(
      p_value < 0.001,
      "p < 0.001",
      paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3))
    )
  )


# Check p-value labels
print(pvals)


# 9. Create violin + box plots


p <- ggplot(
  long_df,
  aes(
    x = Sex,
    y = Value,
    fill = Sex,
    color = Sex
  )
) +
  
  # Violin
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.4,
    linewidth = 1.0
  ) +
  
  # Box plot
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.15,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  # Arrange panels in requested order
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Feature,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  
  # Colours
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Female" = "#F4A6A6",
      "Male" = "#87CEEB"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Female" = "#E07B7B",
      "Male" = "#5DAEDB"
    )
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "Sex-based Differences in Song-level Acoustic Features",
    x = "Sex",
    y = "Acoustic feature value"
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 13
    ),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    )
  )



# 10. Add p-values


p_final <- p +
  geom_text(
    data = pvals,
    aes(
      x = 1.5,
      y = ymax * 1.08,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4,
    fontface = "bold"
  )


# 11. Display final figure


print(p_final)



# 12. Save high-resolution figure


ggsave(
  "Song_Level_Acoustic_Parameters_Boxplot.jpg",
  p_final,
  width = 12,
  height = 9,
  dpi = 600
)
```


# PCA: Song-level Acoustic Features

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


# Prepare PCA data


Song_Level_Data <- read_csv("Song_Level_Data.csv")

pca_data <- Song_Level_Data %>%
  select(
    Sex,
    `Low.Freq..Hz.`,
    `High.Freq..Hz.`,
    `Delta.Freq..Hz.`,
    `Mean.Freq..Hz.`,
    `Peak.Freq..Hz.`,
    `Delta.Time..s.`,
    Note_Count,
    Note_Pace
  ) %>%
  na.omit()

# Keep sex labels
sex_labels <- pca_data$Sex

# Acoustic features only
pca_features <- pca_data %>%
  select(-Sex)

# Rename variables for clarity
colnames(pca_features) <- c(
  "Lowest_Frequency",
  "Highest_Frequency",
  "Frequency_Bandwidth",
  "Mean_Centre_Frequency",
  "Peak_Frequency",
  "Song_Duration",
  "Note_Count",
  "Note_Pace"
)


# Run PCA


pca_res <- prcomp(
  pca_features,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)


# Variance explained


var_explained <- round(
  100 * summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1:2],
  1
)

print(var_explained)


# PCA scores


pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)

pca_scores$Sex <- sex_labels


# Calculate centroids


centroids <- pca_scores %>%
  group_by(Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    PC1 = mean(PC1),
    PC2 = mean(PC2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check centroid values
print(centroids)


# PCA Plot


p_pca <- ggplot(
  pca_scores,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    colour = Sex,
    fill = Sex
  )
) +
  
  # Points
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  # 95% confidence ellipses
  stat_ellipse(
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.95,
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.20,
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  # Centroids
  geom_point(
    data = centroids,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      colour = Sex
    ),
    shape = 4,
    size = 6,
    stroke = 2.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  # Colours
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      Female = "#E07B7B",
      Male = "#5DAEDB"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      Female = "#F4A6A6",
      Male = "#87CEEB"
    )
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Song-level Acoustic Features",
    x = paste0(
      "PC1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PC2 (", var_explained[2], "%)"
    ),
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  
  # Theme
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 18
    ),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    
    legend.position = "right"
  )


# plot


print(p_pca)


# Save figures


ggsave(
  filename = "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-Plots/PCA/PCA_Song_Level_Centroids.png",
  plot = p_pca,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 800,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-Plots/PCA/PCA_Song_Level_Centroids.tiff",
  plot = p_pca,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)
```




# PCA Biplot: Song-level Acoustic Features

```{r}
library(ggrepel)
library(grid)

# Scores
scores <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$x[, 1:2]
)

scores$Sex <- sex_labels


# Loadings
loadings <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$rotation[, 1:2]
)

loadings$Variable <- rownames(loadings)



# Scale loading arrows to fit PCA scores


mult <- min(
  (max(scores$PC1) - min(scores$PC1)) /
    (max(loadings$PC1) - min(loadings$PC1)),
  
  (max(scores$PC2) - min(scores$PC2)) /
    (max(loadings$PC2) - min(loadings$PC2))
)

mult <- mult * 0.70



# Biplot


p_biplot <- ggplot(
  scores,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2
  )
) +
  
  # Individual songs
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = Sex),
    size = 2.8,
    alpha = 0.65
  ) +
  
  # 95% confidence ellipses
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(colour = Sex),
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  # Loading arrows
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      xend = PC1 * mult,
      yend = PC2 * mult
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "purple4",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.25, "cm")
    )
  ) +
  
  # Loading labels
  geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = PC1 * mult,
      y = PC2 * mult,
      label = Variable
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "navy",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    box.padding = 0.6,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  
  # Colours
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Female" = "#E07B7B",
      "Male" = "#5DAEDB"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "PCA Biplot of Song-level",
    
    x = paste0(
      "PC1 (",
      var_explained[1],
      "%)"
    ),
    
    y = paste0(
      "PC2 (",
      var_explained[2],
      "%)"
    ),
    
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 18
    ),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    legend.title = element_blank()
  )


# Display
print(p_biplot)


# Save
ggsave(
  filename =
    "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-Plots/PCA/PCA_Biplot_Song_Level.png",
  plot = p_biplot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 800,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename =
    "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-Plots/PCA/PCA_Biplot_Song_Level.tiff",
  plot = p_biplot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)
```

# Note-level Acoustic Analysis

```{r}
# NOTE-LEVEL ACOUSTIC ANALYSIS
# Wilcoxon tests + violin/box plots

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)



# 1. Load note-level data


Combined_NoteLevel_Data <- read_csv(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-R script/Combined_NoteLevel_Data.csv"
)

View(Combined_NoteLevel_Data)

# Check column names
colnames(Combined_NoteLevel_Data)


# 2. Calculate note duration


Combined_NoteLevel_Data <- Combined_NoteLevel_Data %>%
  mutate(
    Note_Duration = End.Time..s. - Begin.Time..s.
  )



# 3. Prepare data


df_plot <- Combined_NoteLevel_Data %>%
  select(
    Sex,
    Low.Freq..Hz.,
    High.Freq..Hz.,
    Delta.Freq..Hz.,
    Center.Freq..Hz.,
    Peak.Freq..Hz.,
    Note_Duration
  ) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  rename(
    "Minimum F0" = `Low.Freq..Hz.`,
    "Maximum F0" = `High.Freq..Hz.`,
    "Frequency bandwidth F0" = `Delta.Freq..Hz.`,
    "Mean centre F0" = `Center.Freq..Hz.`,
    "Peak F0" = `Peak.Freq..Hz.`,
    "Note duration (s)" = Note_Duration
  )



# 4. Convert to long format


long_df <- df_plot %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Sex,
    names_to = "Feature",
    values_to = "Value"
  )



# 5. Set parameter order


long_df$Feature <- factor(
  long_df$Feature,
  levels = c(
    "Minimum F0",
    "Maximum F0",
    "Frequency bandwidth F0",
    "Mean centre F0",
    "Peak F0",
    "Note duration (s)"
  )
)



# 6. Wilcoxon rank-sum tests


wilcox_results <- long_df %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    W = wilcox.test(Value ~ Sex)$statistic,
    p_value = wilcox.test(Value ~ Sex)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = ifelse(
      p_value < 0.001,
      "p < 0.001",
      paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3))
    )
  )

print(wilcox_results)



# 7. Save Wilcoxon results


write.csv(
  wilcox_results,
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-R script/Note_Level_Wilcoxon_Results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)



# 8. Calculate p-value positions


pvals <- long_df %>%
  group_by(Feature) %>%
  summarise(
    ymax = max(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    wilcox_results,
    by = "Feature"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    y_position = ymax * 1.08
  )



# 9. Create violin + box plots


p <- ggplot(
  long_df,
  aes(
    x = Sex,
    y = Value,
    fill = Sex,
    color = Sex
  )
) +
  
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.4,
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.12,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Feature,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 3
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Female" = "#F4A6A6",
      "Male" = "#87CEEB"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Female" = "#E07B7B",
      "Male" = "#5DAEDB"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Sex-based Differences in Note-level Acoustic Features",
    x = "Sex",
    y = "Acoustic Feature Values"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    
    strip.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    strip.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15
    ),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      color = "black"
    ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 18
    )
  )



# 10. Add p-values


p_final <- p +
  geom_text(
    data = pvals,
    aes(
      x = 1.5,
      y = y_position,
      label = p_label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold"
  )



# 11. Display plot


print(p_final)



# 12. Save high-resolution figure


ggsave(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-R script/Note_Level_Acoustic_Features_Violin_Boxplots.jpg",
  plot = p_final,
  width = 12,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 600
)
```



# PCA - Note-level Acoustic Analysis

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)


# Load note-level data


Combined_NoteLevel_Data <- read_csv(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-R script/Combined_NoteLevel_Data.csv"
)


# Calculate note duration


Combined_NoteLevel_Data <- Combined_NoteLevel_Data %>%
  mutate(
    Note_Duration = End.Time..s. - Begin.Time..s.
  )


# Prepare PCA data


pca_data <- Combined_NoteLevel_Data %>%
  select(
    Sex,
    `Low.Freq..Hz.`,
    `High.Freq..Hz.`,
    `Delta.Freq..Hz.`,
    `Center.Freq..Hz.`,
    `Peak.Freq..Hz.`,
    Note_Duration
  ) %>%
  na.omit()

# Keep sex labels
sex_labels <- pca_data$Sex

# Acoustic features only
pca_features <- pca_data %>%
  select(-Sex)

# Rename variables
colnames(pca_features) <- c(
  "Lowest_Frequency",
  "Highest_Frequency",
  "Frequency_Bandwidth",
  "Mean_Centre_Frequency",
  "Peak_Frequency",
  "Note_Duration"
)


# Run PCA


pca_res <- prcomp(
  pca_features,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)


# Variance explained


var_explained <- round(
  100 * summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1:3],
  1)

print(var_explained)


# PCA scores


pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
pca_scores$Sex <- sex_labels


# Calculate centroids


centroids <- pca_scores %>%
  group_by(Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    PC1 = mean(PC1),
    PC2 = mean(PC2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(centroids)


# PCA plot


p_pca_PC12 <- ggplot(
  pca_scores,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2,
    colour = Sex,
    fill = Sex
  )
) +
  
  geom_point(
    size = 2.5,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  
  # 95% confidence ellipses
  stat_ellipse(
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.95,
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.20,
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  # Centroids
  geom_point(
    data = centroids,
    aes(
      x = PC1,
      y = PC2,
      colour = Sex
    ),
    shape = 4,
    size = 6,
    stroke = 2.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      Female = "#E07B7B",
      Male = "#5DAEDB"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      Female = "#F4A6A6",
      Male = "#87CEEB"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Note-level Acoustic Features",
    x = paste0(
      "PC1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"
    ),
    y = paste0(
      "PC2 (", var_explained[2], "%)"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 18
    ),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

print(p_pca_PC12)


# Save


ggsave(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-R script/Note_Level_PCA_PC1_PC2_Centroids.png",
  p_pca_PC12,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 800,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-R script/Note_Level_PCA_PC1_PC2_Centroids.tiff",
  p_pca_PC12,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)
```

# Note-level PCA Biplot

```{r}
library(ggrepel)
library(grid)


# PCA scores


scores <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$x[, 1:2]
)

scores$Sex <- sex_labels


# PCA loadings


loadings <- as.data.frame(
  pca_res$rotation[, 1:2]
)

loadings$Variable <- rownames(loadings)


# Scale arrows automatically


mult <- min(
  (max(scores$PC1) - min(scores$PC1)) /
    (max(loadings$PC1) - min(loadings$PC1)),
  
  (max(scores$PC2) - min(scores$PC2)) /
    (max(loadings$PC2) - min(loadings$PC2))
)

mult <- mult * 0.70


# PCA biplot


p_biplot <- ggplot(
  scores,
  aes(
    x = PC1,
    y = PC2
  )
) +
  
  # Individual notes
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = Sex),
    size = 2.8,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  
  # 95% confidence ellipses
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(colour = Sex),
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.95,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  
  # Loading arrows
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = 0,
      y = 0,
      xend = PC1 * mult,
      yend = PC2 * mult
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "purple4",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    arrow = arrow(
      length = unit(0.25, "cm")
    )
  ) +
  
  # Loading labels
  geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(
      x = PC1 * mult,
      y = PC2 * mult,
      label = Variable
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    colour = "navy",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4,
    box.padding = 0.6,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    segment.color = "grey50",
    segment.size = 0.4,
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  
  # Colours
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      Female = "#E07B7B",
      Male = "#5DAEDB"
    )
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  labs(
    title = "PCA Biplot of Note-level Acoustic Features",
    
    x = paste0(
      "PC1 (",
      round(
        summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1] * 100,
        1
      ),
      "%)"
    ),
    
    y = paste0(
      "PC2 (",
      round(
        summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 2] * 100,
        1
      ),
      "%)"
    )
  ) +
  
  theme_bw(base_size = 15) +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 18
    ),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    ),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    
    legend.position = "right"
  )

# Display
print(p_biplot)


# Save biplot


ggsave(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-R script/Note_Level_PCA_Biplot.png",
  p_biplot,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 800,
  bg = "white"
)
```

# Monthly BirdNET Detections of Nilgiri Flycatcher

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)


# Nilgiri Flycatcher detections


bird_nf <- BirdNET_SelectionTable_June2024_to_May2025 %>%
  filter(Species.Code == "nilfly2")


nrow(bird_nf)


# Extract date from Begin.Path


bird_nf <- bird_nf %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(
      str_extract(Begin.Path, "\\d{8}"),
      format = "%Y%m%d"
    )
  )


# Create month


bird_nf <- bird_nf %>%
  mutate(
    Month = month(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
  )


# Set June -> May order

month_order <- c(
  "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov",
  "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May"
)

bird_nf$Month <- factor(
  bird_nf$Month,
  levels = month_order
)


# TOTAL NF detections per month


monthly_total <- bird_nf %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_NF_detections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(monthly_total)


# DAILY NF detections


daily_nf <- bird_nf %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    NF_detections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Month = factor(
      month(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
      levels = month_order
    )
  )


# MONTHLY MEAN DAILY NF detections


monthly_mean <- daily_nf %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Detection_days = n(),
    Mean_daily_NF = mean(NF_detections),
    SD = sd(NF_detections),
    SE = SD / sqrt(Detection_days),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(monthly_mean)


# COMBINE TOTAL + MEAN


monthly_summary <- monthly_total %>%
  left_join(monthly_mean, by = "Month")

print(monthly_summary)
```

# Mean Hourly Detections: Breeding (March–June) and Non-breeding (July–February)

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)


# 1. ONLY Nilgiri Flycatcher detections


bird_nf <- BirdNET_SelectionTable_June2024_to_May2025 %>%
  filter(Species.Code == "nilfly2")


# 2. Extract date and hour


bird_nf <- bird_nf %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(
      str_extract(Begin.Path, "\\d{8}"),
      format = "%Y%m%d"
    ),
    
    Time = str_extract(
      Begin.Path,
      "(?<=_)\\d{6}(?=\\.wav)"
    ),
    
    Hour = as.numeric(substr(Time, 1, 2))
  )


# 3. Keep hours 05:00–18:00


bird_nf <- bird_nf %>%
  filter(Hour >= 5 & Hour <= 18)


# 4. Define breeding and non-breeding seasons


bird_nf <- bird_nf %>%
  mutate(
    Month_num = month(Date),
    
    Season = ifelse(
      Month_num %in% c(3, 4, 5, 6),
      "Breeding",
      "Non-breeding"
    )
  )


# 5. NF detections per hour PER DAY


hour_day <- bird_nf %>%
  group_by(Season, Date, Hour) %>%
  summarise(
    NF_detections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# 6. Calculate mean ± SE


hour_summary <- hour_day %>%
  group_by(Season, Hour) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(NF_detections),
    SD = sd(NF_detections),
    N = n(),
    SE = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check results
print(hour_summary)


# 7. Plot


p <- ggplot(
  hour_summary,
  aes(
    x = Hour,
    y = Mean,
    colour = Season,
    group = Season
  )
) +
  
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = Mean - SE,
      ymax = Mean + SE
    ),
    width = 0.20,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Breeding" = "#D73027",
      "Non-breeding" = "#2C7BB6"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 5:18,
    limits = c(5, 18)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Time (hour)",
    y = "Mean daily NF detections per hour",
    colour = NULL
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16
  ) +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      size = 13
    ),
    
    legend.position = "top",
    
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 13
    )
  )

# Display plot
print(p)


# 8. Save figure


ggsave(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-Plots/Breeding_vs_NonBreeding_Hourly_NF.png",
  p,
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 800
)
```

# Heat Map: Annual NF Acoustic Activity Cycle

## June 2024 – May 2025

```{r}
# Figure: Annual NF acoustic activity cycle
# June 2024 – May 2025


library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)


# Read BirdNET data


bird <- read_tsv(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-R script/BirdNET_SelectionTable_June2024_to_May2025.txt"
)


# ONLY Nilgiri Flycatcher detections


bird <- bird %>%
  filter(Species.Code == "nilfly2")


# Extract date and time


bird <- bird %>%
  mutate(
    File = basename(Begin.Path),
    
    Date = as.Date(
      str_extract(File, "\\d{8}"),
      "%Y%m%d"
    ),
    
    Time = str_extract(
      File,
      "\\d{6}(?=\\.wav)"
    ),
    
    Hour = as.numeric(substr(Time, 1, 2))
  )


# Keep daytime hours


bird <- bird %>%
  filter(
    Hour >= 5,
    Hour <= 18
  )


# Daily detections for each hour


hourly_daily <- bird %>%
  group_by(Date, Hour) %>%
  summarise(
    Detections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Add missing days and hours as ZERO detections


hourly_daily <- hourly_daily %>%
  complete(
    Date = seq(
      min(Date),
      max(Date),
      by = "day"
    ),
    Hour = 5:18,
    fill = list(
      Detections = 0
    )
  )


# Add month


hourly_daily <- hourly_daily %>%
  mutate(
    Month = format(Date, "%b %Y")
  )


# TOP PANEL
# Mean daily NF detections by hour


hour_summary <- hourly_daily %>%
  group_by(Hour) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Detections),
    SD = sd(Detections),
    N = n(),
    SE = SD / sqrt(N),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Top line plot


p1 <- ggplot(
  hour_summary,
  aes(
    x = Hour,
    y = Mean
  )
) +
  
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.2
  ) +
  
  geom_point(
    size = 3
  ) +
  
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = Mean - SD,
      ymax = Mean + SD
    ),
    width = 0.20,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 5:18,
    limits = c(5, 18)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean\nDetections"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16
  ) +
  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      b = 0
    )
  )


# HEATMAP DATA
# Mean daily NF detections for each month × hour


heat_data <- hourly_daily %>%
  group_by(Month, Hour) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanDetections = mean(Detections),
    SD = sd(Detections),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Month order


month_order <- c(
  "Jun 2024",
  "Jul 2024",
  "Aug 2024",
  "Sep 2024",
  "Oct 2024",
  "Nov 2024",
  "Dec 2024",
  "Jan 2025",
  "Feb 2025",
  "Mar 2025",
  "Apr 2025",
  "May 2025"
)


# Complete all month × hour combinations


heat_data <- heat_data %>%
  complete(
    Month = month_order,
    Hour = 5:18,
    fill = list(
      MeanDetections = 0
    )
  )


# Set month order


heat_data$Month <- factor(
  heat_data$Month,
  levels = month_order
)


# HEATMAP


p2 <- ggplot(
  heat_data,
  aes(
    x = Hour,
    y = Month,
    fill = MeanDetections
  )
) +
  
  geom_tile(
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    width = 0.98,
    height = 0.98
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 5:18,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  scale_y_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    expand = expansion(
      add = c(0, 0)
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#deebf7",
    high = "#08519c",
    name = "Mean\nDetections"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Hour of day",
    y = "Month"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16
  ) +
  
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      5, 5, 5, 5
    )
  )


# Combine line plot + heatmap


final_plot <- plot_grid(
  p1,
  p2,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v",
  axis = "lr",
  rel_heights = c(1, 4)
)


# Display final figure


print(final_plot)


# Save high-resolution JPG


ggsave(
  filename =
    "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-Plots/Figure3_NF_AnnualActivityCycle_June2024_May2025.jpg",
  
  plot = final_plot,
  
  width = 14,
  height = 8,
  
  units = "in",
  
  dpi = 600,
  
  bg = "white",
  
  device = "jpeg",
  
  quality = 100
)
```

# Circular Statistics

## Nilgiri Flycatcher: June 2024 – May 2025

```{r}
# Circular statistics for Nilgiri Flycatcher
# June 2024 – May 2025


library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(circular)


# Load data


bird <- BirdNET_SelectionTable_June2024_to_May2025


# Filter ONLY Nilgiri Flycatcher


bird <- bird %>%
  filter(Species.Code == "nilfly2")


# Extract date


bird <- bird %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(
      str_extract(Begin.Path, "\\d{8}"),
      format = "%Y%m%d"
    )
  )


# Keep June 2024 – May 2025


study_start <- as.Date("2024-06-01")
study_end   <- as.Date("2025-05-31")

bird <- bird %>%
  filter(
    Date >= study_start,
    Date <= study_end
  )


# ANNUAL CIRCULAR STATISTICS


# Count NF detections per day

daily_counts <- bird %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    Detections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Convert date to day number

daily_counts <- daily_counts %>%
  mutate(
    StudyDay = as.numeric(Date - study_start) + 1
  )


# Convert day of year to circular angle

daily_counts$Angle <- circular(
  2 * pi * daily_counts$StudyDay / 365,
  units = "radians",
  modulo = "2pi"
)


# Weight each day by number of detections

annual_angles <- rep(
  daily_counts$Angle,
  daily_counts$Detections
)

annual_angles <- circular(
  annual_angles,
  units = "radians",
  modulo = "2pi"
)


# ANNUAL RESULTS


mean.circular(annual_angles)

rho.circular(annual_angles)

sd.circular(annual_angles)

rayleigh.test(annual_angles)



# DIEL CIRCULAR STATISTICS


# Extract time

bird <- bird %>%
  mutate(
    Time = str_extract(
      Begin.Path,
      "(?<=_)\\d{6}(?=\\.wav)"
    ),
    
    Hour = as.numeric(substr(Time, 1, 2)),
    
    Minute = as.numeric(substr(Time, 3, 4)),
    
    TimeDecimal = Hour + Minute / 60
  )


# Keep 05:00–19:00

bird_day <- bird %>%
  filter(
    TimeDecimal >= 5,
    TimeDecimal <= 19
  )


# Count detections per hour

hourly_counts <- bird_day %>%
  group_by(Hour) %>%
  summarise(
    Detections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Convert hour to circular angle

hourly_counts$Angle <- circular(
  2 * pi * (hourly_counts$Hour - 5) / 14,
  units = "radians",
  modulo = "2pi"
)


# Weight by number of detections

diel_angles <- rep(
  hourly_counts$Angle,
  hourly_counts$Detections
)

diel_angles <- circular(
  diel_angles,
  units = "radians",
  modulo = "2pi"
)


# DIEL RESULTS


mean.circular(diel_angles)

rho.circular(diel_angles)

sd.circular(diel_angles)

rayleigh.test(diel_angles)
```



# Annual Radial Plot

## June 2024 to May 2025

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)


# 1. Keep ONLY Nilgiri Flycatcher detections


bird_nf <- BirdNET_SelectionTable_June2024_to_May2025 %>%
  filter(Species.Code == "nilfly2")


# 2. Extract date


bird_nf <- bird_nf %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(
      str_extract(Begin.Path, "\\d{8}"),
      format = "%Y%m%d"
    ),
    Month = month(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
  )


# 3. Calculate daily NF detections


daily_counts <- bird_nf %>%
  group_by(Date, Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Detections = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# 4. Calculate mean daily NF detections per month


monthly_summary <- daily_counts %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(Detections),
    SD = sd(Detections),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(monthly_summary)


# 5. Ensure June → May order


monthly_summary$Month <- factor(
  monthly_summary$Month,
  levels = c(
    "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov",
    "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May"
  )
)


# 6. Radial plot


p <- ggplot(
  monthly_summary,
  aes(x = Month, y = Mean)
) +
  
  geom_col(
    width = 1,
    fill = "steelblue4",
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  
  coord_polar(start = 0) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Monthly vocal activity of Nilgiri Flycatcher",
    x = "",
    y = "Mean daily NF detections"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16
  ) +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      face = "bold",
      size = 18
    ),
    
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 13,
      face = "bold",
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 11,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    panel.grid.major = element_line(
      colour = "grey85",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = NA
    ),
    
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white",
      colour = NA
    )
  )


# Display plot

print(p)


# 7. Save TIFF


ggsave(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-Plots/Fig5_NF_Monthly_Radial_Plot.tiff",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  compression = "lzw",
  bg = "white"
)


# 8. Save PNG


ggsave(
  "F:/IISER Tirupati/NF-BirdNet/NF-Plots/Fig5_NF_Monthly_Radial_Plot.png",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 8,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```
